scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:server && npm run check:web
scripts.check:server: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/server test && npm --prefix apps/server run build
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run e2e
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/server run build
